body: Back to draft: #405 (#318) merged to main after this review. This branch and main don't compile together: `rest/across.rs:108` has no arm for the new `carry::Entry::NewBlock`. Fix on this branch: merge main, treat `NewBlock` like `Clip` in the rest chain (a new blank, so rest never reads setup 1's cuts), update across.rs's "waits for #320" comments, and add a test for a flipped setup picked "Its own stock". Then re-gate, and a delta check before it's flagged ready again.

Round 2 is pushed (d0e5d07). The PR stays a draft.

- **Merged `origin/main`** (c66568c), which brings in #405 / #318. There were no textual conflicts.
- **`rest::across::chain_of`**: `Ok(Entry::Clip | Entry::NewBlock) => break`. "Its own stock" in a different hold now ends the rest chain exactly the way the clip does. Rest starts from the setup's own block and never reads Setup1's cuts. I did not use a wildcard. An explicit "What Setup1 leaves behind" on a setup that holds the part the same way and is not linked carries the stock through the same `carry::entry` call, in rest as in the sim.
- **`across.rs` comments**: the module law and the loop comment now name the #320 pick and no longer say the fresh-block question "waits for #320". `docs/decisions/320-stock-source.md` records this.
- **Review nit**: `render_source`'s `format!` strings now use `\n` escapes. The sheet output is unchanged.
- **New tests in `rest_across_setups`**:
  - `a_turned_setup_picked_its_own_stock_does_not_read_the_first_setups_cuts`: at 30°, the unpicked carry is refused, and picking Own removes the refusal and Face2 generates. At 180°, the unpicked carry makes a suppressed Face1 refuse the post, and picking Own does not.
  - `a_same_held_setup_picked_what_setup1_leaves_reads_its_cuts`: the picked carry produces the same Rest2 path as the single-setup reference, and a suppressed Rough1 refuses the post by name.
- **Changed test**: `setup_stock_source::a_refused_carry_and_the_first_setup_cannot_be_picked` now also asserts that generating Face2 before the pick is refused by name. Since #318, the rest chain refuses that generation.
- **Gate on d0e5d07**: all green.
  - app: lib (95), rest_across_setups (7), setup_stock_source (6), setup_carry (5), setups (11), remachining (6), golden_cl (23), posting (17), stock_sim_document (9), setup_sheet (7), project_roundtrip (69), setup_relative (8), commands_undo (32)
  - ui lib from `crates/ui`: 310 passed, 2 ignored
  - clippy `-D warnings` on app and ui, all targets: clean
